en.description:
Experience a bold re-imagination of the classic Pong! This is Pong like you’ve never seen it before—played in a 360-degree field where your goal is to keep the ball contained for as long as possible.

Choose from 5 thrilling difficulty levels to match your style, whether you’re casually chasing high scores or diving into a competitive frenzy with friends and family. As you climb higher, the music intensifies, speeding up with your score to crank up the excitement!

Now featuring Nearby Multiplayer, you can host or join local matches with players around you for competitive head-to-head action. Multiplayer sessions support dynamic gameplay with tactical moments, including power-up interactions that can quickly swing momentum.

Take the fun wherever you go—play on your iPhone or right from your Apple Watch for non-stop action.

Features:
360-degree Pong gameplay
Multiple difficulty levels for solo play
Nearby local multiplayer
Power-up driven match moments
Play on iPhone and Apple Watch

Can you rise to the challenge and set the ultimate high score? It’s time to play!
en.subtitle: Pong on an Axis
